verdict.rationale: Godot has first-party documentation for GDScript and C#, and a community user says it 'generally has good documentation'. Community notes also suggest GDScript has more public examples than C#, and the Asset Library offers demos and templates. Nothing shows LLM-generated code working on the first try or long-term API stability, and some reports cut the other way: an older user gave up over poor scripting documentation, and C# is said to have far fewer examples. missing for 10: evidence of LLM first-try code success, documented API stability/backward compatibility, corroboration of abundant public examples, AI-readable docs (llms.txt/.md mirrors 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, LLM-generated code mostly works on the first try — stable, well-documented APIs with abundant public examples the models have seen

citations.quote: In some areas it's quite low level but generally has good documentation.
GDScript is a high-level, object-oriented, imperative, and gradually typed programming language built for Godot.
